source_of_truth.rule: Edit the canonical JSON first, regenerate both views, validate, and commit all three together. Browser-local checkboxes are personal working notes and never alter shared status.

mission: Build a deterministic, auditable, read-only-first system that discovers equivalent sports contracts on Kalshi and Polymarket, computes executable cross-venue opportunities conservatively, and graduates to trading only after measured safety gates and explicit owner approval.
current_focus: Phase 1 — convert the verified live MLB corpus into pinned offline replay fixtures with complete lineage.
next_action: P1-05: add a deterministic replay fixture loader.
operating_rules: Precision before recall: an uncertain pair is REVIEW or UNSUPPORTED, never EXACT.
Raw source payloads and hashes remain immutable and replayable.
No credentials, account actions, funds, orders, or trading until the execution phase is explicitly approved.
Every completed task must cite durable repository evidence and pass its stated acceptance gate.
Only one task is in_progress; autonomous work proceeds in listed priority order unless Avi or Yoni redirects it.
Scope begins with pre-game binary head-to-head markets; broader families stay in the canonical model but are activated only through measured expansion gates.
Generated views must never be edited directly.

decisions.decision: Use one canonical JSON plan and generate Markdown plus standalone interactive HTML from it.
decisions.reason: Prevents drift while serving implementation and stakeholder needs.

decisions.decision: Implement a narrow pre-game head-to-head vertical slice first while preserving the all-sports taxonomy.
decisions.reason: Produces measurable precision sooner without discarding the broader equivalence design.

decisions.decision: Keep all work read-only through shadow validation; trading is a separately approved phase.
decisions.reason: No real-account or money risk is needed to validate ingestion, matching, and pricing.

decisions.decision: Treat exact material-rule evidence as mandatory for EXACT.
decisions.reason: Similar titles or missing rule fields cannot prove payout equivalence.

decisions.decision: Treat deterministic event-identity matches as REVIEW until cancellation and postponement payout equivalence is proven.
decisions.reason: Live MLB payloads expose materially different fair-price versus 50-50/carry-forward behavior; matched titles and starts alone are not trade-safe.

milestones.name: Specification and repository foundation
milestones.exit: Equivalence policy, public adapters, immutable snapshot writer, and baseline documentation exist.

milestones.name: Reliable raw discovery
milestones.exit: Green tests; representative bounded captures; documented field coverage; replay fixtures; failure telemetry.

milestones.name: Canonical contracts
milestones.exit: Versioned event, participant, predicate, lifecycle, and material-rule models parse the MVP corpus deterministically.

milestones.name: Deterministic matcher
milestones.exit: Candidate generation and evidence-rich decisions meet the labeled precision gate on replay fixtures.

milestones.name: Executable pricing
milestones.exit: Synchronized books, Decimal depth walking, fees, freshness, and safety buffers produce conservative opportunity records.

milestones.name: Review surface and shadow run
milestones.exit: Operators can audit every signal; sustained shadow evidence meets reliability and profitability gates.

milestones.name: Execution readiness

phases.name: Foundation and equivalence policy
phases.objective: Establish the safety contract, public venue boundaries, and replayable raw evidence.

tasks.title: Define cross-venue equivalence decisions and material-rule matrix
tasks.acceptance: Specification defines EXACT, REVIEW, NO_MATCH, UNSUPPORTED, lifecycle handling, and all material dimensions.

tasks.title: Create Python 3.12 package and public API adapters
tasks.acceptance: Kalshi and Polymarket public endpoints are represented behind testable clients.

tasks.title: Implement bounded JSON HTTP behavior
tasks.acceptance: Timeouts, transient retry/backoff, JSON validation, request timing, and non-retryable errors are covered.

tasks.title: Implement union sports catalog capture
tasks.acceptance: Kalshi sports series/markets and Polymarket sports/events/markets are captured with pagination safeguards and deduplication.

tasks.title: Persist atomic immutable JSONL snapshots
tasks.acceptance: Manifest and records include complete payload, provenance, timing, and SHA-256; writes are atomic.

tasks.title: Verify unauthenticated production connectivity
tasks.acceptance: All four read-only checks return HTTP 200 without credentials.
evidence: Verified 2026-08-12: Kalshi markets, Polymarket markets/sports/market-types all HTTP 200

tasks.title: Establish rolling-plan system
tasks.acceptance: Canonical JSON deterministically generates Markdown and standalone HTML, with validation and public publication.

phases.name: Reliable raw discovery and field audit
phases.objective: Turn initial ingestion into a complete, regression-safe evidence corpus for the MVP.

tasks.title: Restore a green test baseline
tasks.acceptance: All declared unit tests pass; request counting behavior is asserted correctly.
evidence: tests/test_ingestion.py:43 corrected to the seven actual adapter requests

tasks.title: Capture a bounded representative production corpus
tasks.acceptance: Sanitized or ignored replay corpus covers at least 20 representative markets per venue for the initial league/family, plus malformed and edge cases.
evidence: data/reports/live-mlb-matches.json: bounded 2026-08-12 report includes 76 Kalshi markets, 173 Polymarket events, and 33 normalized pairs
tests/test_live_matching.py: malformed/unknown, ambiguity, variant, and time-window edge cases

tasks.title: Audit venue field coverage against equivalence requirements
tasks.acceptance: A checked matrix maps every canonical/material field to endpoint, source field, availability, and fallback; gaps have explicit REVIEW/UNSUPPORTED behavior.

tasks.title: Capture complete market rules and lifecycle evidence
tasks.acceptance: Adapters fetch the most authoritative exposed rule text/source and lifecycle fields, or record a typed unavailability reason.
evidence: docs/live-mlb-field-audit.md documents authoritative fields and typed fail-closed behavior

tasks.title: Add deterministic replay fixture loader
tasks.acceptance: Tests run offline from pinned sanitized payloads with source metadata and hashes.

tasks.title: Harden pagination, rate-limit, malformed payload, and partial-capture behavior
tasks.acceptance: Adversarial tests prove bounded termination, explicit partial/failure manifests, retry limits, and no silent record loss.

tasks.title: Version and validate raw snapshot schema
tasks.acceptance: Schema validation rejects invalid manifests/records and a compatibility policy covers future versions.

tasks.title: Add quality tooling and canonical commands
tasks.acceptance: One documented command runs formatting/lint, type checks, unit tests, and schema/plan validation in a clean environment.

tasks.title: Document data retention and redaction policy
tasks.acceptance: Policy distinguishes ignored raw production captures, sanitized committed fixtures, retention, and prohibited secrets/PII.

phases.name: Canonical sports contracts
phases.objective: Normalize source-specific payloads into typed, versioned, explainable contracts.

tasks.title: Define versioned canonical data models
tasks.acceptance: Typed models cover source identity, event, competition, participants/roles, predicate, grading period, lifecycle, and every material-rule field without float thresholds.

tasks.title: Implement exact time and decimal normalization
tasks.acceptance: UTC conversion retains original timezone/text; Decimal parsing preserves exact operators and thresholds; edge cases are tested.

tasks.title: Create league-scoped participant and competition registries
tasks.acceptance: Aliases map to stable canonical IDs; unknown/ambiguous aliases fail closed with evidence; unrestricted substring matching is absent.

tasks.title: Implement canonical event identity
tasks.acceptance: Identity handles participant roles, start windows, stage/game number, neutral sites, doubleheaders, reschedules, and authoritative IDs.

tasks.title: Implement Kalshi MVP contract parser
tasks.acceptance: Representative pre-game head-to-head contracts normalize deterministically; unsupported/missing fields emit reason codes.

tasks.title: Implement Polymarket MVP contract parser
tasks.acceptance: Same canonical and failure contract as Kalshi across the replay corpus.

tasks.title: Build normalization evidence records
tasks.acceptance: Every normalized value links to source snapshot hash, source field/excerpt, parser version, and transformations.

tasks.title: Make equivalence cases executable
tasks.acceptance: The labeled fixture corpus contains full structured inputs and tests every expected decision rather than descriptions only.
evidence: tests/fixtures/equivalence_cases.json currently contains descriptive cases only

tasks.title: Gate MVP parser quality
tasks.acceptance: All labeled MVP fixtures parse reproducibly; unknown fields never become equality; parsing coverage and failure reasons are reported.

phases.name: Candidate generation and deterministic matching
phases.objective: Produce high-precision, evidence-rich cross-venue equivalence decisions.

tasks.title: Implement broad, bounded candidate generation
tasks.acceptance: Candidates require sport/competition/participants and compatible start window, prefer authoritative event IDs, and retain rejection reasons.

tasks.title: Implement ordered equivalence decision engine
tasks.acceptance: Parseability, event, predicate, outcome-space, material-rule, lifecycle, uniqueness, and evidence checks run in policy order.

tasks.title: Implement complementary-outcome proof
tasks.acceptance: Paired legs guarantee intended combined payout across every resolution state; multiway/incomplete spaces fail closed.

tasks.title: Emit machine-readable decision evidence
tasks.acceptance: Every decision contains policy/parser versions, normalized comparisons, source hashes, excerpts, and stable reason codes.

tasks.title: Add ambiguity and uniqueness quarantine
tasks.acceptance: Multiple surviving events/contracts, reschedules, repeated fixtures, and unresolved aliases cannot become EXACT.

tasks.title: Add reviewer workflow and expiring overrides
tasks.acceptance: Review records capture identity, timestamp, snapshot hashes, scenario proof, differences, and expiry; overrides remain pricing-ineligible in this phase.

tasks.title: Build adversarial and property-based matcher suite
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover reversed teams, consecutive games, regulation vs advance, postponement, DNP, pushes, neutral sites, exhibitions, unknowns, and deterministic replay.

tasks.title: Meet matching release gate
tasks.acceptance: Zero known false-positive EXACT decisions and at least 99% precision on a sufficiently sized independently reviewed labeled corpus; recall is reported, not optimized at precision's expense.

phases.name: Order books and conservative opportunity pricing
phases.objective: Turn semantic matches into freshness- and depth-aware executable opportunity records without trading.

tasks.title: Normalize venue order books to a $1 payout model
tasks.acceptance: YES/NO sides, price, quantity, tick, sequence/source time, and venue semantics are represented consistently using Decimal.

tasks.title: Capture matched books with timing evidence
tasks.acceptance: Book pairs record source and local receipt times, retrieval skew, failures, and atomic comparison identity.

tasks.title: Implement depth walking and common-fill quantity
tasks.acceptance: VWAP and maximum common executable quantity are calculated across levels with deterministic rounding tests.

tasks.title: Implement versioned venue fee models
tasks.acceptance: Fee schedules, rounding, settlement/withdrawal assumptions, and effective dates are configurable and evidenced.

tasks.title: Measure and set freshness thresholds
tasks.acceptance: Quote-age and pair-skew limits derive from observed latency/movement distributions; stale/suspended books are excluded.

tasks.title: Implement conservative opportunity engine
tasks.acceptance: Both venue directions compute payout minus depth cost, fees, settlement assumptions, and configurable safety buffer; negative/uncertain cases do not signal.

tasks.title: Add opportunity expiry and invalidation
tasks.acceptance: Signals expire on age, book movement, lifecycle change, rule/evidence change, or match supersession.

tasks.title: Verify pricing invariants
tasks.acceptance: Adding fees/slippage cannot improve profit; reducing depth cannot increase executable quantity; replay is deterministic; displayed midpoint is never treated as executable.

phases.name: Review surface, operations, and shadow validation
phases.objective: Make every decision inspectable and measure real-world reliability before any execution work.

tasks.title: Implement persistent audit storage
tasks.acceptance: Raw references, normalized contracts, decisions, books, opportunities, reviews, and resolutions have migrations, indexes, lineage, and retention rules.

tasks.title: Build read-only operator review surface
tasks.acceptance: Operators can inspect source links/rules, normalized comparisons, reason codes, freshness, book depth, fees, and opportunity math without mutation ambiguity.

tasks.title: Add health, quality, and drift metrics
tasks.acceptance: Metrics cover adapter latency/errors, catalog volume, parser coverage, unsupported/review rates, candidate/match rates, stale books, and policy/parser drift.

tasks.title: Run continuously under single-owner scheduling
tasks.acceptance: One supervised collector/scanner instance has locks, bounded resources, graceful shutdown, restart safety, health checks, and no overlapping capture corruption.

tasks.title: Create alert policy and deduplication
tasks.acceptance: Only fresh qualifying opportunities alert; updates/deduplication/rate limits prevent spam; every alert links to audit evidence.

tasks.title: Audit post-resolution agreement
tasks.acceptance: Both venue resolutions are compared to canonical outcomes; every divergence is investigated and feeds policy/fixture updates.

tasks.title: Complete sustained shadow run
tasks.acceptance: At least several hundred reviewed events and a representative operating window record theoretical fills, subsequent movement, resolutions, false positives, uptime, and net results after modeled costs.

tasks.title: Pass go/no-go review for execution design
tasks.acceptance: A signed evidence summary demonstrates matching precision, data reliability, modeled profitability, failure behavior, and unresolved risks; otherwise remain read-only.

phases.name: Execution and controlled rollout
phases.objective: Design trading as an isolated, explicitly approved subsystem after shadow gates pass.

tasks.title: Confirm legal, jurisdiction, venue, tax, and account requirements
tasks.acceptance: Owners explicitly approve documented eligibility and operational constraints before credentials or funds are introduced.
tasks.blocker: Requires owner decisions and real venue/account context.

tasks.title: Design secret, identity, and least-privilege controls
tasks.acceptance: Credentials are external to Git/logs, scoped minimally, rotatable, audited, and separated between environments.

tasks.title: Implement isolated order gateways
tasks.acceptance: Authenticated venue clients enforce idempotency, limits, validation, dry-run/sandbox modes, and complete request/response audit without secret leakage.

tasks.title: Implement two-leg execution state machine
tasks.acceptance: Partial fills, rejection, timeout, cancel/replace, hedge/unwind, and non-atomic legging risk have explicit bounded states and tests.

tasks.title: Add pre-trade risk controls and kill switches
tasks.acceptance: Per-trade/day/venue/event exposure, balance, loss, staleness, divergence, and manual/global kill switches fail closed.

tasks.title: Implement reconciliation and incident recovery
tasks.acceptance: Orders, fills, positions, cash, and settlements reconcile independently; restart and discrepancy runbooks are exercised.

tasks.title: Complete sandbox and fault-injection campaign
tasks.acceptance: Network loss, stale data, one-leg fills, duplicate responses, venue downtime, process crash, and clock skew pass deterministic recovery tests.

tasks.title: Run owner-approved small-capital canary
tasks.acceptance: Explicit capital/loss limits, human confirmation, live monitoring, and rollback are approved; results are reviewed before scaling.

tasks.title: Scale only through measured gates
tasks.acceptance: Each increase requires sustained reconciliation, realized profitability, incident-free operation, and owner sign-off; limits remain reversible.

risks.risk: Venue APIs may not expose enough authoritative rule detail to prove exact payout equivalence.
risks.mitigation: Field audit; fail closed to REVIEW/UNSUPPORTED; investigate official rule endpoints before matching.

risks.risk: Cross-venue fills are non-atomic and can leave an unhedged position.
risks.mitigation: No execution before P6; model legging risk, state machine, exposure limits, and kill switches.

risks.risk: Catalog, schema, fee, or resolution behavior can drift without code changes.
risks.mitigation: Version evidence, schema checks, volume/drift metrics, replay tests, and post-resolution audits.

risks.risk: Quote skew, stale books, fees, rounding, and insufficient depth can turn apparent edge into loss.
risks.mitigation: Synchronized timing evidence, Decimal depth walking, measured freshness limits, all-cost pricing, and safety buffer.

risks.risk: Ambiguous participants, reschedules, repeated fixtures, and market variants can create false matches.
risks.mitigation: Canonical IDs, authoritative event mapping, stage/game identity, ambiguity quarantine, adversarial fixtures.

risks.risk: Human/public plan views can drift from implementation status.
risks.mitigation: Canonical JSON, deterministic generation, CI-style validation, evidence requirement, and same-commit updates.

risks.risk: Quality tooling remains incomplete despite a green baseline test suite.
risks.mitigation: P1-08 will establish one canonical verification command covering formatting/lint, types, tests, schemas, and plan generation.
